description: This file defines the SynchronousCommandExecutor class, which implements the CommandExecutor interface to execute commands synchronously within the Fineract project. It manages middleware invocation, routing to the appropriate handler, and returns a supplier for the result.

classes.name: SynchronousCommandExecutor
classes.description: A Spring component that executes commands synchronously, processing middleware and routing to the appropriate handler.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the provided command by invoking middleware, routing to the proper command handler, and returning a supplier for the handler's result.
